scope: Ten packaged Electron screenshots from successful candidate CI run 41197110354, inspected individually.
limitations: Chromium composition does not certify physical OS keyboard or IME behavior.
Screenshots supplement native event and input/output assertions; they do not certify all visual layouts.

images.observation: Korean terminal heading and active composition are visible and readable.
Korean search query, result count and scrollback controls are visible.
Six panes render and the sidebar reports fifteen sessions with one waiting item. Narrow panes wrap controls and clip terminal columns; this is not a claim of wide-pane readability.
Remote project/worktree hierarchy and disconnected/error labels are visible.
The resumed shell shows the typed echo command and the resulting MCW_RESUMED_INPUT_OK output line.
